skin_cls.metadata_source: ISIC API (age is rounded to 5 years; ~19% of age, sex and site values are missing and shown as 'unknown')

skin_cls_milk10k.metadata_source: MILK10k: skin tone 0 (very dark) to 5 (very light), distinct from Fitzpatrick; grades 0 and 1 merged (6 lesions have grade 0)
skin_cls_milk10k.note: the only dataset with skin-tone grades; this measures the model outside its training distribution, so differences mix skin tone with dataset shift

brain_cls.dataset: Brain Tumor MRI Dataset, leakage-free test split
brain_cls.note: the dataset carries no age, sex or scanner metadata, so only the per-class audit is possible; recall per class is the subgroup metric

bone_det.operating_point: threshold fixed on the validation split (90% specificity there)

cxr_chex.label: Lung Opacity
cxr_chex.note: ages above 90 are kept as recorded; the FNR column uses the threshold that targets a 10% miss rate overall
